name: DummyObject
summary: Fills a parameter that has to be there and is never used, so that a test can call what it needs to call without inventing something meaningful.

roles.name: DummyObject
roles.summary: The emptiest of the doubles: passed around, never called. Annotating it says the emptiness is the point — nothing should ever invoke it, so the day something does, a test is exercising a path nobody meant to describe.
